_about: Made-up inbox for testing the Gmail brief. Priorities and deadlines are the author's judgement (the 'known answers'). hoursAgo keeps every message inside the default 2-day window. Not real mail.

emails.subject: Revised quote - need your answer
emails.body:
Hi Kyle,

Thanks for sending the revised quote for the office renovation. The numbers look fine to us, but my partner needs to see a written confirmation of the timeline before we sign.

Can you confirm the start date and send it back to me by Friday 5 PM? If we do not hear from you by then we will have to ask the other contractor.

Thanks,
Maria
